title: Roof Replacement in Portland, OR
summary: In August 2026, French Roofing replaced the roof on a home in Portland, OR. The old reddish brown three-tab shingles were replaced with new brown architectural asphalt shingles, and the plumbing vent pipes got new flashings. The finished roof has an even, layered look across every plane.
scope: Replaced the old three-tab shingles with new architectural asphalt shingles
New flashings around the plumbing vent pipes
Shingled around the chimney and the roof vents
body: Before the work, the roof was covered in reddish brown three-tab shingles, and one of the vent pipes sat in a metal flashing with rust stains running down it. The new roof is a brown architectural shingle with a more textured, layered look.
